verdict.rationale: Paychex Flex has a conventional human-oriented developer portal (REST/OAuth overview, use cases, a 'Get Started' tool kit), but nothing in the evidence describes llms.txt or agent-oriented documentation. A direct probe of developer.paychex.com/llms.txt returned 404, and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found at common paths. Ordinary developer docs are an adjacent feature and earn no credit for this story.
